# TestScript for 28-explicit-config-file
# Asserts conga.ConfigExplicit(...) semantics: bootstrap.yaml is the
# application's default file (fatal if missing), and a file the user names
# outranks it: --config-file first, then the WEB_CONFIG environment variable.

# 1. The programmatic explicit file loads without any flag
exec explicit-config-file
stdout '⚙  explicit-config-file'
stdout '-c, --config-file\s+conga\.ConfigFile\s+bootstrap\.yaml\s+● config bootstrap\.yaml'
stdout '--host\s+string\s+explicit\.example\.com\s+● config bootstrap\.yaml'
stdout '-p, --port\s+int\s+9100\s+● config bootstrap\.yaml'

# 2. WEB_CONFIG outranks the explicit option
env WEB_CONFIG=env.yaml
exec explicit-config-file
stdout '-c, --config-file\s+conga\.ConfigFile\s+env\.yaml\s+● env WEB_CONFIG'
stdout '--host\s+string\s+env\.example\.com\s+● config env\.yaml'
stdout '-p, --port\s+int\s+9300\s+● config env\.yaml'

# 3. The --config-file flag outranks WEB_CONFIG
exec explicit-config-file -c override.yaml
stdout '-c, --config-file\s+conga\.ConfigFile\s+override\.yaml\s+● cli --config-file'
stdout '--host\s+string\s+override\.example\.com\s+● config override\.yaml'
env WEB_CONFIG=

# 4. The --config-file flag outranks the explicit option
exec explicit-config-file -c override.yaml
stdout '-c, --config-file\s+conga\.ConfigFile\s+override\.yaml\s+● cli --config-file'
stdout '--host\s+string\s+override\.example\.com\s+● config override\.yaml'
stdout '-p, --port\s+int\s+9200\s+● config override\.yaml'

# 5. --why shows the explicit candidate that loaded
exec explicit-config-file --why
stdout 'bootstrap\.yaml\s+loaded'
stdout '--host\s+explicit\.example\.com\s+config \(bootstrap\.yaml\)'
stdout '--port\s+9100\s+config \(bootstrap\.yaml\)'
! stdout '██████'

# 6. Missing explicit file is fatal: exit 1, not a usage error
rm bootstrap.yaml
exit-status 1 explicit-config-file
stderr 'cannot read config file "bootstrap\.yaml"'

# 7. Missing explicit file under --why fails fast with ErrConfig (non-tolerant pipeline)
exit-status 1 explicit-config-file --why
stderr 'cannot read config file "bootstrap\.yaml"'

-- bootstrap.yaml --
host: explicit.example.com
port: 9100

-- override.yaml --
host: override.example.com
port: 9200

-- env.yaml --
host: env.example.com
port: 9300
